Effective November 14, 2022, Spee Dee Delivery has adjusted its fuel surcharge rates and
indexes to better align with the industry standards.
Spee Dee Delivery’s habit of traditionally only changing rates annually caused us to fall well
behind the industry leaders. Their changes have occurred as anticipated and/or actual fuel cost
increases have taken place. We will likely follow their lead in the future.
Since July 2021 one industry leader has made four increases to their ground package FSC index:
July 2021 = +1.50%
October 2021 = +0.75%
April 2022 = +2.00%
October 2022 = +1.75% totaling 6.00%
On the package side, our FSC rate is increasing 3% on each 12-cent step in the index.
LTL industry leaders adjusted their fuel surcharge index rates back when fuel prices reached
about $3.60 per gallon. Given today’s diesel fuel prices the LTL index will gain roughly 11%.

Spee-Dee Delivery has strengthened operations with continued investment in our ﬂeet, TMS (Transportation Management System)
technology, and expanded service throughout Kansas and Missouri. We appreciate your partnership and would like to share key
updates for 2026.
E"ective January 5, 2026
• 4% overall base rate increase on parcel and pallet shipments
• Pricing updates to Additional Charges – a limited list of accessorials, most of which do not impact the average shipper
Spee-Dee Delivery remains committed to cost-e"ective, simplistic pricing
• No Peak Season or Demand Surcharges

• No Residential Delivery Surcharges on parcel shipments

March 31, 2025
Spee-Dee Delivery proudly announces Missouri and Kansas expansions effective Monday, April 7, 2025
Spee-Dee Delivery began servicing the Kansas City market last April. Thanks to the positive feedback and support
we’ve received from our customers, we have decided to further expand our footprint in Missouri and Kansas.

Customers can begin shipping into the three-digit ZIP Code prefixes 634-635, 644-646, 650-653 (Missouri) and
660, 666 (Kansas) effective with their April 7 parcel and pallet shipments.
VERY IMPORTANT: If your company utilizes Spee-Dee Ship Software you must use rates version RATES2025C
in order to ship into the expanded service area beginning on April 7 (rates version can be found on the bottom of
shipping manifest). Expansion ZIP Codes will automatically become enabled in the software on April 7. Not using the
current version? Simply update TODAY so you don’t miss out! Current Spee-Dee Ship Software is available to download
at SpeeDeeDelivery.com/update. Or reach out to Spee-Dee Delivery’s IT Department at (800) 862-5578 x 500 for
assistance TODAY! Companies that utilize a third-party manifest vendor are encouraged to reach out to their provider
to ensure the new ZIP Codes have been added to their shipping capabilities effective April 7.
We are thrilled to introduce Spee-Dee shipit powered by Dispatch Science. This innovative cloud-based Transportation

Management System (TMS) will enhance the customer experience and deliver features requested by shippers. Be sure
to watch for upcoming communication about Spee-Dee shipit. Login instructions and support information will be
forthcoming to shippers to ensure a smooth transition.
We are pursuing new shippers within our expanding footprint. If you have affiliated companies or vendors in the
expansion ZIP Codes, and they may be interested in setting up a shipping account, please have them reach out to
our Customer Relations team at sales@speedeedelivery.com or (800) 862-5578. You can also provide us with their
contact information, and we would be happy to reach out to them.
Enclosed is a Days in Transit map specific to your shipping location. Customers can visit SpeeDeeDelivery.com/maps
to view or download the map specific to your shipping location. Our Delivery Area Surcharge (DAS) ZIP Code list and
all Zone Charts have been updated to include the new ZIP Codes. Visit SpeeDeeDelivery.com/rates to view or
download the updated information.

Thank you for being a valued partner. We appreciate the opportunity to better serve our customers through service
enhancements and technology upgrades. Please don’t hesitate to reach out to our Customer Relations Department
at sales@speedeedelivery.com or (800) 862-5578 if you have any questions or would like more information.

Spee-Dee Delivery is a regional delivery and logistics company that has served the
Upper Midwest since 1978. Known for our reliable, cost-effective parcel delivery
services, Spee-Dee Delivery operates within ten states including Illinois, Iowa, Kansas,
Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, North Dakota, South Dakota, and Wisconsin.
Our company focuses on providing next-day and second-day delivery to customers of all
sizes, with an emphasis on customer service, competitive rates, and regional expertise.
Spee-Dee LTL offers fast, cost-effective regional freight shipping for customers across
the Upper Midwest. With reliable transit times, real-time tracking, and personalized
customer service, Spee-Dee ensures efficient delivery of LTL shipments. Our extensive
regional network enables next-day service to many areas, making us a trusted partner for
customers seeking dependable, affordable logistics solutions with the same trustworthy
service that defines our parcel operations.
Spee-Dee Logistics further enhances our company’s capabilities by offering customized

warehousing, fulfillment, and distribution solutions. Designed to streamline supply
